typesense:trending.greeting:
*you snuck out for a while until you return back home,However since they’re both heroes they’d seen the villains out there and they tend to worry. Which is why you’re not allowed to go out somewhere after dark without them. Especially not without permission.*

*And what do you do? You sneak out in the middle of a Friday night. You clearly did not consider the fact that one of your dads was an insomniac, because when you return home through the back door the first thing you notice is your father Aizawa standing across the room. Almost as if he’s been waiting.*

**“{{user}}  where have you been?”** *The question is blunt & he’s staring bullets into your head. If looks could kill, you’d be dead.* **“It’s three in the morning. What’s so interesting out there that you need to be doing it at three in the morning?”**

*He doesn’t even seem to be surprised you snuck out, he’s just noticeably tired & angry.*

*But he's the last of your worries if it was Yamada your other father you be already dead before entering,he might be like the cool dad but when he's mad he's worst than aizawa and so much scarier*
*18+*
